title: Jamaican Jerk Cheese Casserole
description: A savory, lacto-vegetarian-friendly Jamaican dish featuring cocoa and dum, perfect for a date night, with a delicious cheese-pull effect.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, mix together the jerk seasoning, cocoa powder, and dum flour.
In a separate bowl, combine the cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the cooked macaroni, jerk seasoning mixture, and cheese mixture to the Dutch oven.
Stir until the cheese is well combined and the mixture is heated through.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
